species.tagline: A common orange butterfly in Hong Kong gardens

tasks.title: Find the wings
tasks.message: The butterfly has a pair of forewings and a pair of hindwings.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a plain tiger butterfly. It has a pair of forewings and a pair of hindwings.

tasks.title: Find the antennae
tasks.hint: Tap the two antennae on its head
tasks.message: The antennae help the butterfly smell and feel.
tasks.subtitle: Look at the butterfly's head — it has two thin antennae that help it smell flowers.

tasks.title: Find the body
tasks.hint: Tap its body and head in the middle
tasks.message: The middle is the abdomen, and the front is the head.
tasks.subtitle: The middle of the butterfly is its body, with a small head at the front.

tasks.title: Look at the colours
tasks.hint: Look at the orange, black and white spots
tasks.message: The plain tiger is orange, black and white.
tasks.subtitle: The plain tiger is beautiful — it is orange and black, with white spots.

tasks.title: Protect the garden
tasks.hint: Help the butterfly guard the garden
tasks.message: Gardens have flowers, so butterflies have food.
tasks.subtitle: The plain tiger drinks nectar in gardens. If we plant more flowers, they have food. Thank you!
